$comment: Generated by tools/space-shape.mjs from space-shape.config.json (space: normal, shape: rounded). The theme's space and radius roles. Never edit by hand.

stack-pair.$description: Stacked pair that reads as one: label and field, title and subtitle

stack-row.$description: Between rows of a list whose rows carry their own fill (navigation items, menu items), so two fills never touch

stack-group.$description: Groups within a section; fields in a form

inline-item.$description: Items in one row: buttons in a group

inline-group.$description: Groups in a row: toolbar groups

inset-xs.$description: Inside a compact group, around each member’s fill: a segmented control

inset-sm.$description: Inside compact containers: menus, list rows

inset-lg.$description: Inside dialogs, sheets and page regions

gutter.$description: Between columns and regions of a layout

margin-page.$description: Content to window edge on small screens

sm.$description: Small parts: badges’ marks, inline code, checkboxes, keys

md.$description: Controls and the things built like them: buttons, fields, menus, list items

pill.$description: Shapes drawn as pills by choice, not by nature: badges and the outer ends of a whole bar; square when the shape is sharp
